messages:
maria: FYI ECR scan flagged a medium CVE in one of our base layers (libxml2). thinking we should do a targeted rebuild for the 'compact-runtime' base image and roll through canary. any RBAC or KMS signing gotchas we should plan for?

jason: +1 on rebuild. main things: build pipeline needs access to KMS signer key, and the signing role should be limited to the build account. we'll add an ephemeral assume-role for the CI job.

maria: @jason can you call out the IAM perms you'll need? i want to avoid giving broad kms:Encrypt etc to the entire pipeline service account.

jason: plan: create iam role 'ci/cosign-signer' with sts:AssumeRole from the ci principal, grant kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey on the key alias used for cosign; deny kms:Decrypt. also log key usage to CloudAuditLogs. minimal perms.

oliver: also add a condition on the assumeRole to only allow from the specific workflow run OIDC sub claim and tag builds with build_id.

sarah: for audit logs, we'll need a mapping between cosign payloads and our image SBOM/CI build ID so we can trace which build produced a given digest. add fields: build_id, git_sha, sbom_url in the cosign annotations.

maria: good. want to confirm rollout plan: 1) rebuild base image with patched libxml2 2) sign images in CI 3) push canary tag to staging cluster 4) run e2e + vuln scan 5) promote. any recommended throttles on canary?

kev-oncall: for runtime safety, add automatic fallback policy in the router for the canary route for 10m. if any OOMs or auth-failures hit >5% we rollback. also ensure alerting on image pull failures.

jason: CI snippet i'll use (cosign):

```
# sign in CI after successful push
COSIGN_PASSWORD=${{ secrets.COSIGN_PW }}
cosign sign --key kms://projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-sign ${IMAGE_URI} \
  --annotations build_id=${BUILD_ID} git_sha=${GIT_SHA} sbom=${SBOM_URL}
```

oliver: small nit: cosign via KMS currently stores signatures in OCI registry refs; ensure our registry retention policy doesn't garbage collect signatures before the image is promoted. also add a verification step in the deploy pipeline that checks `cosign verify` and the annotations.

sec-alert-bot: [automated] new vuln triage created: VULN-2026-1432 affecting libxml2 in compact-runtime. severity: medium. assigned: sarah.

sarah: i'll own triage. quick questions: do we pin libxml2 to distro security backport or rebuild from source? distro backport keeps smaller delta but sometimes older ABI.

maria: prefer distro backport if available and security team validates. fallback is rebuild-from-source and run our fuzz tests.

jason: RBAC change plan: we'll open PR to infra-iam with the new ci/cosign-signer role, key policy, and an auditor role that has kms:GetPublicKey and logs read. put lifetime 1h on STS tokens for CI.

kev-oncall: incident response play: if a signed image is later found vulnerable, we need a rapid denylist in our admission controller. i've drafted an admission webhook update that checks cosign annotations and queries a denylist configmap by digest. would like two approvers before rolling that to prod.

maria: love that. can we also emit an audit event when the admission controller denies a pod so sec team sees which deploy triggered it?

oliver: yes — admission webhook will POST to /audit-collector with payload: {digest, image, namespace, deployer, reason}. keep payload minimal. logs stored for 90d.

infra-bot: CI build started for compact-runtime@2026-03-20T12:03:45Z (build_id=br-4721).

sarah: i've kicked off vulnerability repro steps and will report back within the hour. planning to run the patched package in a staging container and run small workload to catch regressions.

maria: timeline: aim to have signed canary image by EOD, staging rollout overnight, full promote tomorrow morning if green. i'll prepare runbook snippets for oncall.

jason: PR will reference this thread and include terraform diff for the role + kms key policy. tagging @maria for review.

maria: thanks — if anyone sees unexpected image-pull errors after canary push ping #eng-oncall and i'll coordinate rollback. :thumbsup:

sarah: update: patched package OK in staging container, no immediate regressions from smoke tests. pushing to staging cluster canary in 15m.

kev-oncall: I'll watch the alerting dashboards. setting a temporary 3m alert for image-pull-fail and 1% error rate on readiness probes for the canary deployment.

sec-alert-bot: [automated] triage note added to VULN-2026-1432: recommended mitigation: backport package available (debian-security) — patch validated by sarah.

maria: closing loop: will merge RBAC PR after jason updates assumeRole condition. final checklist: kms key policy, ci role, cosign annotations, admission denylist webhook update, audit events enabled.

jason: ack. I'll keep keys rotated via monthly automatic rotation and will add a runbook entry for emergency key revocation and image re-sign plan.

maria: great work team. logging this thread into the incident ticket. thanks all. :sparkles:
